claims.summary: McShane documents subject omission in later clauses of a series of three or more sequential actions with the same subject referent; the article is narrowed to that pattern and no longer presents omission after any two coordinated clauses as a general rule.

locator.label: § 4.2.2, pp. 120–121, lines 932–961: in a series of three or more sequential clauses with the same referent, later subjects can and often should be omitted; the paper gives corpus examples.
